name: @mandusec/reply-filter
description: Mandu user-reply egress chokepoint (cooperative wrapper layer; paper: resolve symbols in user-facing replies, OpenClaw hook message_sending). A wrapper CLI that routes the agent's output through a desymbolizing stream filter: $MDU:* tokens in the agent's user-facing output are resolved to their ORIGINAL values via the arbiter's deep desymbolize (HumanView fidelity — the human always sees real data), while the agent's own context keeps the symbols. Piped/print runs filter through a plain pipe; interactive TUIs on a TTY are relayed through a PTY (util-linux script on Linux; BSD script on macOS, with a companion that relays resizes and signals BSD script does not) so the TUI keeps a real terminal while replies resolve. UTILITY-ONLY surface: on any arbiter failure the filter passes text through UNCHANGED (symbols stay opaque — fail-closed toward symbolic, nothing can leak). All resolution goes through the arbiter over IPC; this package never opens the symbol DB directly.
